name: Get a daily email of new jobs from jobs.ch, jobup.ch, JobScout24 and job-room.ch

parameters.content:
### How it works
This workflow helps job seekers in Switzerland get one daily email instead of checking four job boards. Every morning it runs each of your searches across jobs.ch, jobup.ch, JobScout24 and job-room.ch through an Apify actor. It removes excluded words and low workloads, merges the same job posted on several boards and skips jobs you already received. Days without a new job send no email. If one search fails you get an alert and the others still arrive. No spreadsheet is needed: sent jobs are stored in the workflow itself for 90 days.

### Setup
You need an Apify account (the free plan works, the actor charges per job) and Gmail.
1. Create a Header Auth credential: name `Authorization`, value `Bearer YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN`.
2. Fill in the Configuration node: one search per line as `keyword | place`, your exclude words, minimum workload and email.
3. Connect Gmail and run once to check the email.
4. Activate the workflow.

### Customization
Add more search lines; each one is a separate Apify run. Set minWorkload to 0 to keep all jobs. Jobs without a stated workload are always kept.

Limitation: n8n only saves the memory of sent jobs on activated workflows. Manual test runs do not, so a manual run can repeat jobs.

## Run your searches
Turns each line of the Configuration node into one search across jobs.ch, jobup.ch, JobScout24 and job-room.ch.

## Filter and remove repeats
Drops excluded words and low workloads, merges the same job from different boards and skips jobs already sent.

## Send and remember
Sends one email, then stores the jobs so they never arrive twice. No new job means no email.

## Failed search
A failed search sends an alert. The other searches still run and arrive in the digest.
